issue_title: Missing newline at end of file with multiple array of tables can corrupt during dumping
issue_text:
Parsing a TOML document whose last array-of-tables entry has no trailing newline, with other tables defined in between, produces corrupted output when dumped: the output cannot be re-parsed.

```python
import tomlkit

content = '''[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'''  # note: no trailing newline

doc = tomlkit.parse(content)
print(doc.as_string())
```

Actual output:
```
[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[[products]]
name = "Nail"[foo]

[bar]

```

The second `[[products]]` entry is glued to `[foo]` without a newline, so re-parsing the dumped output raises `tomlkit.exceptions.UnexpectedCharError: Unexpected character: '[' at line 5 col 13`. The dump must be valid TOML that round-trips to the same data.
test_command:
python -c "import tomlkit; content = '[[products]]
name = "Hammer"

[foo]

[bar]

[[products]]
name = "Nail"'; doc = tomlkit.parse(content); out = doc.as_string(); re = tomlkit.parse(out); assert re == doc, 'round-trip data changed'; print('OK')"
success_criteria: Dumped output of a document with multiple array-of-tables and no trailing newline must be valid TOML and round-trip to identical data.
